assumptions.claim: Each user creates a hiding individual proof locally; an aggregator receives only that opaque proof and its public root/nullifier/recipient/relayer/fee statement.
A future accepted outer relation verifies every individual proof and binds the exact canonical statement hash chain passed by the settlement contract.
Known-root membership is supplied by the integrating pool root registry; the research harness uses a conspicuously permissive model registry only for component tests.
Pull-payment recipients can retry claims after receiver failure; failed calls revert the credit deletion.
Threshold latency rows use stationary independent Poisson arrivals; fixed-window rows are policy bounds, not observed timing.
Proof submissions are noncustodial and nonexclusive, so a user may resubmit to another aggregator or use the required individual withdrawal path.
The SHA-256 model proof tokens and mutable Foundry binding verifier are relation test oracles only.
The 2^24 active gas cap and SP-70 14M/1M-or-70-percent gates are evaluated only against complete transaction metrics.
